overview: Prism-Edit decomposes the guidance difference vector in diffusion models into semantic layers based on information density to enable precise, disentangled image editing, particularly for challenging background modifications.

modules.name: Guidance Vector Core
modules.description: Computes the guidance difference vector between target and source conditions and implements the theoretical derivations (Tweedie's formula, KL-based bounds) for validating the Semantic Scale Hypothesis.

modules.name: Semantic Map Extraction
modules.description: Extracts the raw semantic map by probing a specific high-noise timestep window, computing the average guidance difference magnitude, and applying Z-score normalization to counteract information imbalance.

modules.name: Semantic Layer Decomposition
modules.description: Implements the thresholding logic on the Z-score normalized semantic map to separate the signal into distinct semantic layers, identifying high-magnitude object cores and low-magnitude background/style regions.

modules.name: Dynamic Guidance Modulator
modules.description: Implements the default editing modality by dynamically binarizing the guidance weights at each step and scaling the guidance difference vector with a region-specific scale factor based on semantic layers.

modules.name: Static Mask Processor
modules.description: Implements the optional mask generation pipeline by thresholding the semantic map and applying morphological closing operations to ensure spatial contiguity and remove holes in the editing mask.

modules.name: Static Blending Processor
modules.description: Implements the optional latent blending logic where the edited latent representation is blended with the source latent representation based on the static mask to enforce strict preservation in unedited regions.

modules.name: Diffusion Inversion Engine
modules.description: Implements latent inversion techniques (DDIM, DDPM, DPM-Solver) required to obtain the initial noise trajectory from a source image to initiate the editing process.

modules.name: Baseline Editor Adapters
modules.description: Provides wrapper classes and integration hooks to inject the Prism-Edit dynamic or static modulation logic into existing state-of-the-art editing frameworks like Prompt-to-Prompt, PnP, and LEDITS++.

modules.name: Dataset & Prompt Manager
modules.description: Manages the loading of benchmark datasets (Wild-TI2I, ImageNet-R-TI2I, CUB-200) and handles the configuration of source, target, and negative prompts for various editing scenarios.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Suite
modules.description: Calculates evaluation metrics including DINOv2 for semantic alignment, SSIM for structural preservation, CLIP for text alignment, LPIPS for perceptual similarity, and the specific DINOv2/SSIM ratio for disentanglement.

modules.name: Quantitative Benchmark Runner
modules.description: Orchestrates the full evaluation pipeline across baseline methods and Prism-Edit on standard benchmarks, computing metrics for object-centric and background-centric subsets to generate comparison tables.

modules.name: Ablation & Sensitivity Analyzer
modules.description: Configures and executes controlled experiments for hyperparameter sensitivity, including the guidance scale factor for different semantic intervals, probe window selection, and static versus dynamic modality comparisons.

modules.name: Robustness & Causality Tester
modules.description: Implements scripts for cross-solver robustness analysis (DDIM vs. DPM-Solver), prompt variation tests, and causal validation by independently editing high-magnitude and low-magnitude semantic layers.

modules.name: Visualization Generator
modules.description: Generates visual outputs including temporal evolution plots of guidance magnitude, semantic map overlays, qualitative comparison grids, and statistical histograms of the guidance difference vector.
